Net flow methodology ↗

Successful inflows minus successful outflows, by asset and comparable UTC days. Failed transfers are excluded; refunds are not added twice. This net flow measures neither bank balances nor transit.

Daily net flow over seven days

The rolling seven days end on the last date of the selected reporting period. Positive net flows are blue above zero, negative net flows are red below zero. A dot marks a bar too small to see. A dash indicates unavailable data.

Supply outside ICS20 escrow is local supply minus units held by the IBC transfer module. Figures cover registered representations and are expressed in product units.

Verified transit through the Hub

Source chain → Cosmos Hub → next hop

PFM subset: a receipt and a send linked within the same executed message, with verified routing instructions and bank movements. Confirmed transit requires both packets to succeed toward a chain different from the source.

Identified routes

Assets of confirmed transits

Manual transfers, delayed forwarding and unlinked retries remain outside this measurement. An unlinked receipt is not classified as non-transit. The next hop does not prove final settlement; this subset does not measure global centrality.

How to read the indicators

  • Subcriteria 1.1 and 1.3all blocks in the day are checked. If fee evidence is missing, fees and ratios remain unavailable.
  • Subcriterion 1.2coverage of the event index; a consistent index can still omit transactions.
  • Prices:historical daily references. Current spot prices are never applied retrospectively; assets without prices remain unvalued.
  • Short history:one point is an observation, not a trend. Missing days are not extrapolated.
